assets.prompt: Precision Cinema Engineering. Flat, sharp geometric industrial editorial design, generous whitespace, crisp typography, no robots, no 3D, no neon cyberpunk, no gradients. Accent colors #3B82F6 timeline blue, #F59E0B crop amber, #EF4444 privacy red. Use real editable SVG text, system sans-serif fonts, large readable labels, not outlined text. No scripts, animation, external fonts, images, href, foreignObject, CSS imports, links or embedded base64. All text must fit. Output ONLY one complete SVG, no Markdown fences. SVG namespace http://www.w3.org/2000/svg. Do not invent performance numbers, repair success, independent AST APIs, dedicated zoom-in tools or zero-drift guarantees. Canvas viewBox="0 0 1280 720"; width=1280 height=720. Theme dark: background #090D16, foreground #F8FAFC. Title: Inspect first. Request images when needed. Show Agent <-> MCP state inspection <-> Symbolic timeline, then branching only on visual uncertainty to Contact sheet and Selected source frame. Exact API labels: fablecut_get_project {compact:true}, fablecut_patch_project, fablecut_frame {path,frames,from,to}, fablecut_frame {path,t}. Arrows return visual results to Agent. Bottom compare two workflows: Full-frame sampling: image evidence throughout; MontClip workflow: state summary, then selected images. Add: No token or latency benchmark claimed. Local FFmpeg and browser compositor; external AI service is optional. Do not imply semantic recognition happens locally. Never use url(), marker, filter, gradient, pattern, style attributes or style elements; draw arrowheads as small polygon elements and use only plain fill/stroke attributes.
assets.validated: XML structure and reference allowlist only; visual review pending
